title: Do China's Top Parks Need Advance Booking? (2026) | China Travel Expert
description:
Fly all the way to China's most famous park and you can still be turned away at the gate — because you didn't book online first.

Since 2017 almost every Chinese scenic area, museum and palace runs on real-name ticketing. The busiest 5A sites and the Forbidden City need an advance online reservation, usually 1-7 days ahead, and barely sell anything at the door. The catch for visitors: the official apps often want a Chinese ID or phone number and reject foreign-passport payment.

🧭 Expert Tip: Book 2-3 days ahead on Trip.com (or through your hotel / a travel agency) using your passport — far cheaper than losing the day at a sold-out gate.

中国热门景区基本都要实名预约（2017年起），一般提前1-7天网上订票，现场几乎不卖；官方App常只认中国身份证——外国护照用 Trip.com 预订。
